fix.boundary: Nodes without a text Delta do not create an idle text caret handle. Active text drags retain recognizers while passing non-text nodes; non-text range/caret anchors use a zero-width one-logical-pixel-high block-edge rectangle, expanded only by the platform handle style. Text endpoint geometry is unchanged.

fixture_setup_failures: juejin-embed and figma-embed originally used disallowed fixture hosts; corrected before final verification

android_integration.actions: Real header/body touch creates an inline collapsed selection; no MobileCollapsedHandle appears over idle cards; meeting/task open callbacks and deletion, resource settings/cancel/deletion, image edit and video play/pause remain reachable.
text_regressions: dragging the actual right range handle
caret drag across an intervening card
range selection drag across an intervening card
android_integration.gesture_target: Inner GestureDetector of DragHandle; the outer DragHandle Stack may cover the selection rectangle and is not a valid handle hit target.

isolation_and_limits.business_and_network_services: Local callback, WebView and player substitutes; image uses a data URI. No collaboration engine or authenticated business data is opened.
isolation_and_limits.keyboard_service: Disabled in device selection tests to keep the viewport stable; this does not validate the physical input method.
isolation_and_limits.ios: Not run on an iOS device/simulator.
isolation_and_limits.unadapted_blocks: Generic Delta boundary applies, but every future/custom block visual is not individually exercised.

deployment_side_effect.observed: Initial flutter drive runs omitted --keep-app-running. The tool uninstalled the same-package app at completion, clearing local application data.
deployment_side_effect.future_prevention: Documented --keep-app-running and adb install -r for normal Demo restoration.
